breakdown.description: The prompt ignores the contribution of the average normal stress to the in-plane shear state; the maximum in-plane shear depends on both σ_avg and τ_avg.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification correctly includes both σ_avg and τ_avg in the maximum in-plane shear stress formula: τ_max = sqrt((σ_avg/2)² + τ_avg²). It does not ignore the normal stress contribution, computing (16.667/2)² = 69.444 MPa² alongside τ_avg² = 2.779 MPa², yielding τ_max = 8.498 MPa. This matches the ground truth approach where both stress components contribute to the in-plane shear state.
